notes: Top and bottom loop independently. Their full 1080px canvases align at y=0; do not additionally shift the bottom image downward. Artwork is confined to the top or bottom 435px, as requested in v5. Only these two foreground strips repeat; background, midground and side borders remain finite. Borders are separate optional room pieces. Use straight-alpha blending; foregrounds are decoration, not collision geometry.
